decisive_items: compound heterozygous alterations (c.2992 + 2T>G and c.8621-30A>G) at splice sites in COL7A1
Immunofluorescence and transmission electron microscopy of the grafted area showed type VII collagen and anchoring fibrils
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including genetic testing, microscopy results, and clinical presentation. R1 is the runner-up because it also has strong support, but it is more specific to the revertant mosaicism aspect, which is a subset of the broader diagnosis of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R3 and does not provide any new information beyond what is already present in R3.
